entryDescription: The teacher offers meeting times. You book one for {child}.
title: Parent-teacher conference
description: Book a meeting with the teacher of {child}. You only see free times.
empty: There is currently no parent-teacher conference for the class of {child}.
chooseHint: Tap a time to book it.
moveHint: Tap another time to move your appointment.
noFree: There are no free times left.
rule: You can book, move or cancel up to 24 hours before the meeting. The appointment then appears in your calendar.
locked: Your appointment is less than 24 hours away. To change it, please contact the teacher directly.
cancelBody: Your appointment at {time} will be cancelled. The time becomes free for other families.
